shields_note: Posted in the 'Pre-Starting 1 (10)' section with Fear Is My Ally: ten Defensive Shields, listed outside the 60.
notes: Posted 6 November 2001, before Theed Palace, so the format is Premiere - Reflections III.

Fear Is My Ally (posted under 'Pre-Starting') and the 7 cards under 'Starting 7' (This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time, Cloud City: Upper Walkway, Imperial Arrest Order & Secret Plans, Prepared Defenses, I'm Sorry, They Must Never Again Leave This City, You Cannot Hide Forever / Staging Areas) count toward the 60.
The ten shields under 'Pre-Starting' dested the Dark Reflections III Defensive Shield printings, not the Effects of the same names; the strategy lists which three to start per matchup.

Posted 'You Cannot Hide Forever/Staging Areas' dested You Cannot Hide Forever & Mobilization Points: Staging Areas is the Light half of the Light combo, and this is the only Dark You Cannot Hide Forever combo.
Posted 'Do, Or Do Not/Wise Advise' (Effects) is kept as written: Do, Or Do Not & Wise Advice is a Light card and no Dark card matches.

Posted 'Cloud City East Platform' dested Cloud City: East Platform (Docking Bay) (the strategy calls it the Docking Bay); 'Destroyer Droids' dested Destroyer Droid; 'SFS L-s9.3 Laser Cannon' dested SFS L-s9.3 Laser Cannons; 'Abyssian Ornament' dested Abyssin Ornament; 'Short Range Fighters' dested Short-range Fighters; 'Where Are Those Droidekas' dested Where Are Those Droidekas?!.
The list totals 60 as published, plus 10 shields.
